name: Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KL International / Sepang)

handling.v: handling services 24 hours, by prior arrangement with the aerodrome administration (no agents named)
handling.quote: Handling services available H 24 & by prior arrangement with the aerodrome administration.

slots.v: under civil non-scheduled flights, the AIP says airlines must get slot time confirmation from National Slot Coordination Malaysia (NSCM) before applying to CAAM; it says 'airlines' and does not mention private aircraft separately
slots.quote: All airlines operating to all airports in Malaysia must contact National Slot Coordination Malaysia (NSCM) for slot time confirmation in IATA SCR format before submitting to CAAM

permits.v: non-scheduled flights need prior permission through NOSAS or AEROFILE; apply at least 3 working days ahead or approval may not be processed in time
permits.quote: Prior permission must be sought and obtained either by NOSAS or AEROFILE system.; Flight approval might not be processed in time if the application is less than three (3) working days.
